app.name: Agri Sathi
home.heroText: Crop guides, a stage-by-stage calendar, pest solutions and fertiliser doses — works offline once opened.
home.glossaryText: Plain-language meanings of farm terms and common questions — searchable, offline.
crop.useInCalendar: Make my calendar for this crop
calendar.title: My crop calendar
calendar.intro: Pick your crop and the date you sowed (or transplanted). We will lay out every stage with the dates and the tasks.
calendar.nothingToday: No stage-specific task window right now — keep monitoring the field.
calc.title: Input & dose calculator
calc.intro: Enter your field size to get seed quantity, fertiliser bags and spray water — based on the crop's recommended package.
calc.disclaimerShort: Estimates only. Adjust to your soil test and always follow the product label.
search.noResults: No crop found. Try another word.
myfarm.title: My Farm
myfarm.intro: Your crops, what stage they are at, and what to do this week.
myfarm.empty: You have not added a crop yet.
myfarm.emptyCta: Add a crop to your calendar
myfarm.finished: This crop's cycle is complete. Remove it or keep it for records.
myfarm.notStarted: Not started yet — sowing date is in the future.
myfarm.nothingThisWeek: No stage-specific task window right now. Keep scouting the field twice a week.
diagnose.title: Diagnose a problem
diagnose.intro: Tell us the crop, where on the plant you see the problem, and what it looks like. We will show the most likely causes and what to do — starting with non-chemical steps.
diagnose.step3: 3. What do you see? (choose any that fit)
diagnose.noneYet: Pick a crop and at least one symptom to see possible causes.
diagnose.noMatch: No close match. Try fewer or different symptoms, or open the crop's Pests & Diseases page directly.
diagnose.disclaimer: This is a guide, not a firm diagnosis. Confirm with your KVK or agriculture officer before spraying, and always follow the product label.
weather.title: Weather & spray advisory
weather.intro: A 7-day forecast for your field, safe spray windows, and alerts for frost, heat and heavy rain.
weather.gpsFailed: Could not get GPS. Enter your location manually, or move to open sky and try again.
weather.offline: You are offline. Showing the last forecast saved on this phone.
weather.noData: No forecast yet. Connect to the internet once to load it.
weather.sprayWhy.rain: Rain expected — spray will wash off
weather.sprayWhy.heat: Too hot — spray will evaporate and may scorch
weather.sprayWhy.ok: Low rain and wind, mild temperature
weather.alert.frost: Frost risk: temperature near or below 2 °C. Light evening irrigation or smoke can protect a flowering crop.
weather.alert.heat: Heatwave: max above 40 °C. Irrigate in the evening; avoid spraying; stress at flowering cuts yield.
weather.alert.rain: Heavy rain expected (over 50 mm in a day). Open drainage channels now; do not spray; delay fertiliser top-dressing.
weather.alert.dry: No rain for 7 days. Plan a life-saving irrigation, especially if a crop is flowering or filling grain.
weather.alert.none: No weather alerts for the next 7 days.
weather.check1: No rain forecast for at least 6 hours after spraying.
weather.check2: Wind is light — below about 15 km/h; leaves barely moving.
weather.check3: Not the hottest part of the day — spray early morning or late afternoon.
weather.check4: The crop is not wilting from water stress.
weather.check5: You are wearing a mask, and covering skin; keep others and animals away.
weather.forCrop: For a crop you are growing
disclaimer.title: Please verify before you act
disclaimer.text: This guidance follows standard Package of Practices. Local conditions, soil tests and current pest advisories matter. Confirm doses and pesticides with your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or agriculture officer before applying.
about.title: About Agri Sathi
about.missionText: To put trustworthy, plain-language crop guidance in every farmer's pocket — free, offline, and in your language.
about.sourcesText: Crop entries are compiled from ICAR and State Agricultural University Package of Practices, Krishi Vigyan Kendra advisories, and CIB&RC-approved pesticide labels. Each crop page lists its sources and the date it was last reviewed.
about.correctionsText: Agriculture is local and knowledge changes. If something looks wrong for your area, please tell us so an agronomist can review it.
about.offlineText: Once you have opened Agri Sathi with internet, it keeps working without a network. Add it to your home screen for one-tap access.
